visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an outdoor urban courtyard paved with gray circular brick patterns. A young woman with short black hair in pigtails, wearing a yellow t-shirt and an orange overall dress, stands with her back to the camera. She covers her eyes and counts. In the background, a group of six young men and women walk cautiously toward her under a pedestrian bridge. (2) The girl turns her head rapidly toward the camera, exposing her face which has bright pink circles painted on her cheeks. The group behind her freezes immediately in exaggerated poses. A man in a gray hoodie strikes a hand-on-hip pose as an image of a celebrity appears in a digital overlay above him. Yellow variety-style text pops up on the screen. (3) The girl turns back to count again, and then whips around for a second time. This time, a man in a green beanie and jacket gestures toward his face. A new celebrity image overlay appears. The background shows apartment buildings with numerous air conditioning units and a small sign for a community center. (4) The sequence repeats for a third time. A woman in a white puffer jacket poses with her hand near her hair. An image of a female pop star is superimposed over her. The camera zooms in slightly on different group members as they struggle to maintain their frozen poses. (5) The game concludes in a chaotic celebration. All group members begin dancing and singing along to music. A man in a navy hoodie shouts excitedly at the camera in a close-up shot. The girl in the yellow dress laughs and turns toward the lens, her painted-on red cheeks and wide smile taking up most of the frame as the others continue their energetic movements in the background.
